[[File:Fable_Astin_training_SWJ8.jpg|thumb|Wax candles being used in lightsaber training exercise]]
{{Quote|After a second it started spraying fire&mdash;thermal projectiles that melted our armor like wax.|Canderous Ordo|audio=CanderousWax-KOTOR.flac|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
'''Wax''' was a sticky yellowish meltable substance.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> It saw uses as diverse as moulding [[Candle/Legends|candles]]<ref name="Y:DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> and grooming one's mustache<ref name="LL">{{Tales|3|Lady Luck (comic story)}}</ref> or beard to make it shiny.<ref name="BTR">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] even created a weapon, known as the [[burnball]], that consisted in an wax shell filled with [[Biohazard|hazardous]] [[hanpat]] chemical.<ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> The [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], a race of giant [[Insect/Legends|insects]], made balls of luminescent wax to light the dark passageways of their dwellings.<ref name="Apoc">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> Wax of the [[Cornesian Wax|Cornesian variety]] was once used by [[Ninopas Orocc]], who smeared it across the base of several [[Repulsorpod/Legends|hover platforms]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], which resulted in the injury of three [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> The [[Faalo's cadences]], a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training techniques developed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vo'ren Faalo/Legends|Vo'ren Faalo]], involved manipulating [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] ball bearings atop wax candles.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> On [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] wax was used to seal letters, written on parchment.<ref name="SWAJ14">''{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}''</ref>
